component.subject: Call to Worship
component.source: Psalm 134 (World English Bible); "Yahweh" rendered "the Lord", opening "Look!" omitted, "even he who" rendered "The Lord who".

original.p: Psalm 134 (WEB): Look! Praise Yahweh, all you servants of Yahweh, who stand by night in Yahweh’s house! Lift up your hands in the sanctuary. Praise Yahweh! May Yahweh bless you from Zion; even he who made heaven and earth.

p.line: Praise the Lord, all you servants of the Lord,
Who stand by night in the Lord’s house!
Lift up your hands in the sanctuary.
May the Lord bless you from Zion;
The Lord who made heaven and earth.
